name: Shanweiniao
sum: Long-snouted enantiornithean from the Yixian Formation of China with a tail fan of feathers.
holotype: DNHM D1878/1 and D1878/2, slab and counterslab of one skeleton, Dalian Natural History Museum.
biology: Forms a long-beaked clade with Longipteryx, Longirostravis and Rapaxavis (O'Connor et al. 2010).
author: O'Connor et al. 2009
